pages.text: MV to ZPM machine hulls are craftable only in an Assembler. The recipe needs a boss drop as a non-consumed catalyst: kill each boss once, keep the item, craft all you like.
MV: Netherite Monstrosity, Monstrous Horn$(br2)HV: Ignis, Ignitium Ingot$(br2)EV: The Harbinger, Witherite Ingot$(br2)IV: Ender Guardian, Gauntlet of Guard
LuV: Maledictus, Cursium Ingot$(br2)ZPM: Scylla, Essence of the Storm$(br2)The Harbinger drops a Block of Witherite: uncraft it into ingots.
